audience.text: Rust developers building applications that need to process Excel .xlsx files without requiring Microsoft Office or a proprietary Aspose runtime.

capabilities.text: Reads and writes Excel .xlsx (OOXML/SpreadsheetML) files from paths, streams, or in-memory bytes with repair options.
capabilities.title: Read and write .xlsx files

capabilities.text: Supports typed cell values (string, i32, f64, bool, decimal, datetime) and formulas with cached results via CellMut.
capabilities.title: Cell value management

capabilities.text: Applies cell styling through CellStyle with Font, Fill, Borders, and NumberFormat, plus conditional formatting rules.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Manages worksheets, rows, columns, merged cells, auto-filters, and structured tables (ListObject) with totals.
capabilities.title: Worksheet organization

capabilities.text: Creates charts (column, line, bar, pie, scatter, etc.), embeds pictures, and draws shapes with AutoShapeType.
capabilities.title: Charts and graphics

capabilities.text: Reads/writes core and extended document properties, applies workbook and worksheet protection, and manages defined names.
capabilities.title: Document properties and protection

capabilities.text: Enforces data validation rules using Validation with types, operators, formulas, and error messages.
capabilities.title: Data validation

capabilities.text: Adds sparkline groups for in-cell trend charts and hyperlinks with screen tips and addresses.
capabilities.title: Sparklines and hyperlinks

limitations.text: Supports only .xlsx (OOXML/SpreadsheetML) format; no legacy .xls, ODS, or CSV handling.
No automated test suite ships yet; cargo test --all-targets reports 0 tests.
Not yet published to crates.io; requires git or path dependency in Cargo.toml.
A workbook must always keep at least one worksheet; removing the last worksheet returns an error.

problems_solved.text: Enables pure-Rust processing of Excel .xlsx files without external dependencies like Microsoft Office or proprietary Aspose runtimes.
Provides a familiar object model (Workbook, Worksheet, Cells) for Rust developers migrating from Aspose.Cells or other spreadsheet libraries.
Supports defensive loading of corrupted XLSX files via LoadOptions repair flags and structured LoadDiagnostics reporting.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust is a pure-Rust library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without external dependencies or proprietary runtimes.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook with Workbook::new(), write typed values and formulas to cells, and save to .xlsx using Workbook::save_xlsx.

workflows.name: Load and inspect workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing .xlsx file using Workbook::load_xlsx or Workbook::load_xlsx_from_bytes, then inspect load diagnostics for issues.

workflows.name: Edit cell values and formulas
workflows.text: Access cells via Worksheet::get_cells_mut(), write values using CellMut::put_value_* methods, and set formulas with cached results.

workflows.name: Apply styling and formatting
workflows.text: Modify cell styles using CellStyle with Font, Fill, and Borders, and apply conditional formatting rules via FormatCondition.

workflows.name: Configure worksheet layout and protection
workflows.text: Set row/column sizes, freeze panes, configure page setup, and apply worksheet/workbook protection using FreezePane and PageSetup.
